_comment: DEV/LIVE-RELOAD ONLY. Never used for the shipped App Store build or any CI/TestFlight build -- Capacitor's own docs describe server.url as a live-reload development tool, not a production distribution mechanism. To use: copy this over capacitor.config.json locally (or pass --config to the Capacitor CLI) while iterating against a local `npm run dev` server, then restore the real capacitor.config.json before committing or building for release. The production config (capacitor.config.json) has no server block and loads the bundled webDir build instead.
